Terrible app over all with only 2 eerily accurate images. Besides the ads and the fact that it has subscription services for most of its features, and I am so sick of less than average apps wanting weekly/monthly/annual monies. The only thing it did that I would qualify as eerily accurate, is a composite it made from a photo where it made a different version of me that actually looks like family members now, and an image of me as a toddler, From a 20 year old photo of me. That was crazy.

To address using properly lit portraits, they are definitely properly lit photos as well as the facial hair is also definitive. Other apps I have used got it right. This seems less about an AI generating something unique based on what it analyzed in a photo rather than a program running code for pre- defined parameters geared towards certain user types. Kodak ran into a similar situation when it introduced facial recognition software.
